logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient of radiolabeled complexes was determined between phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4) and 1-octanol. In brief, 100 μL of 99mTc-based probes was added to a solution comprising 700 μL of PBS and 800 μL of 1-octanol (n = 3), followed by vortex oscillation and centrifugation (5 min, 10,000 rpm). 100 μL portion of each phase was collected and subjected to γ-counter measurement. The results were calculated as follows: D = radioactivity in octanol/radioactivity in the aqueous phase. The final distribution coefficients were expressed as log D ± SD.
